findings.description: force-static makes the initial English brand-detail document fall back to zh-TW translations.
findings.failure_scenario: A request to /en/brands/<slug> returns lang=en and English chrome but server-renders brand detail labels such as 品牌資訊 and 品牌聲明; the scoped i18n E2E test fails before hydration. The exact prefixless route already removes the original middleware loop, so force-static is no longer required.

findings.description: The new exact prefixless route does not carry over the localized brand route's error and not-found boundaries.
findings.failure_scenario: A missing brand or a service failure on /brands/<slug> selects the new route tree, which has no route-specific not-found.tsx or error.tsx, so users lose the localized brand recovery UI that /en/brands/<slug> still receives.

findings.description: Generic argv build detection runs before test and script classification.
findings.failure_scenario: A maintenance script or test invoked with an argument exactly equal to build is attributed as build traffic, defeating the runbook's promised separation of build, test, and script requests.

findings.description: The new traffic context type and classifier are exported despite having no external caller.
findings.failure_scenario: The module exposes two unsupported API symbols and knip reports both, increasing the public surface future refactors must preserve.

findings.description: The new DB regression uses a non-null assertion and unchecked array index instead of an explicit runtime guard.
findings.failure_scenario: A test database without a category containing two approved brands reaches an unsafe categoryEntry!/slugs[0] path; this also violates the governing rule 'Never use unchecked [0] on possibly-empty arrays.'

findings.description: The test covers the pure User-Agent builder rather than recreating a Supabase client and asserting x-client-info wiring.
findings.failure_scenario: A future removal of the global.headers wiring could leave this helper test green while traffic becomes untagged.
